name: DataJud
install: sudo apt-get update -qq && sudo apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends python3-venv && python3 -m venv .venv && . .venv/bin/activate && python -m pip install --upgrade pip && pip install -r requirements.txt && python -m ipykernel install --user --name datajud --display-name "DataJud (.venv)"
